diagnostics.note: Traced diagnostic only; profiler/GL wrappers perturb timing. Do not compare its frame rates with untraced trials. Timeline totals can overlap.

metricSemantics.raf: Actual observed RAF scheduling intervals; first interval excluded.
metricSemantics.counters: Published renderer diagnostics repeat at native ~500ms cadence; read at RAF for correlation, not independent per-frame CPU/GPU measurements.
metricSemantics.open: No tree targets visible plus conservative all-tree clearance beyond horizon+5m. No trees are removed.
metricSemantics.trace: Separate diagnostic Profiler/Tracing run; its timing is excluded from untraced comparison.

scope: Actual production geometry/shaders/lighting and real held-pointer pan. Fixed zoom; routes cross8m/16m boundaries. CPU4x/phone viewport is host emulation, not physical-mobile performance. NPCs continue deterministic600ms ticks; no universal FPS/latency guarantee.
setupProvenance: Captured before conditional foliageQueued-ready gate was added. Baseline has no foliageQueued diagnostic, so the new outside-timed gate would pass immediately. Motion body is unchanged; its hash was backfilled from unchanged source. Measurement samples are untouched. A renderer/native-assets/terrain setup guard and forest-native-presence result guard were added later; the captured baseline datasets satisfy all predicates.
